title.narrative: TWO WORLDS ONE BIRD MECHANISMS TO PROT BICKNELL'S THRUSH IN DOM REPUBLIC III

description.narrative: Objectives to be completed during the grant project period are to: 1) complete and submit to the Ministry of Environment and Natural Resources the documentation necessary to request the registration of a new, 100-hectare private reserve; 2) reforest 200 hectares according to the Plan Vivo carbon offset standard to restore Bicknells Thrush (BITH) habitat, of which no more than 25 hectares were part of a previous NMBCA project; 3) ensure management of the 200 reforested hectares for 20 years; 4) develop a local community-led ecotourism and volunteerism program; 5) set up a BITH monitoring protocol to estimate occupancy and population trends and conduct at least one monitoring effort based on this protocol; 6) implement an annual Christmas bird count (twice during the two-year project period); and 7) train at least 4 scientists, 10 local community park rangers and 10 community members in the buffer zones of three Scientific Reserves (Quita Espuela, Guaconejo, Salcedo) to support the BITH monitoring program and Christmas bird counts.
